name: Schrodinger equation
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="4">

    <description>
        The <a href="http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Schr%C3%B6dinger_equation">Schrödinger equation</a> describes the change in the 
        wave function for some quantum state. For a travelling particle, the magnitude of the wave packet describes the probability the that particle 
        will be found at each location.

        Here a wave packet travels through empty space until it reaches a high energy barrier, which it is reflected from.
        
        In our implementation, 'a' represents the real part of the complex number and 'b' the imaginary part. A fixed energy background is given by 'c'.
        The magnitude is shown in 'd' but doesn't affect the system.
        
        By changing the values of parameter 'potential' and then using 'Generate Initial Pattern' from the 'Action' menu you can change the height
        of the barrier. Or you can paint directly into 'c'.
    </description>

    <rule type="formula" name="Schrodinger equation">
        
      <param name="timestep">    0.001    </param>
      <param name="potential">   4        </param>

      <formula number_of_chemicals="4">
        delta_a = -laplacian_b - c*b;
        delta_b =  laplacian_a + c*a;
        d = hypot( a, b ) + c;
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
    
    <initial_pattern_generator apply_when_loading="true">
        
      <overlay chemical="d">
        <overwrite />
        <gaussian height="1" sigma="0.05">
          <point3D x="0.2" y="0.5" z="0.5" />
        </gaussian>
        <everywhere />
      </overlay>

      <overlay chemical="a">
        <overwrite />
        <sine amplitude="1" phase="0">
          <point3D x="0" y="0" z="0" />
          <point3D x="0.05" y="0" z="0" />
        </sine>
        <everywhere />
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="a"><multiply /><other_chemical chemical="d" /><everywhere /></overlay>
      
      <overlay chemical="b">
        <overwrite />
        <sine amplitude="1" phase="1.5708">
          <point3D x="0" y="0" z="0" />
          <point3D x="0.05" y="0" z="0" />
        </sine>
        <everywhere />
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="b"><multiply /><other_chemical chemical="d" /><everywhere /></overlay>
      
      <overlay chemical="c">
        <overwrite />
        <parameter name="potential" />
        <rectangle>
          <point3d x="0.4" y="0.2" z="0.2" />
          <point3d x="0.5" y="0.8" z="0.8" />
        </rectangle>
      </overlay>
            
      <overlay chemical="d">
        <add />
        <other_chemical chemical="c" />
        <everywhere />
      </overlay>
            
    </initial_pattern_generator>
    
    <render_settings>
       <active_chemical value="d" />
       <show_displacement_mapped_surface value="true" />
       <color_displacement_mapped_surface value="false" />
       <low value="-0.5" />
       <high value="0.5" />
       <vertical_scale_1D value="100" />
       <vertical_scale_2D value="50" />
       <timesteps_per_render value="256" />
       <show_phase_plot value="false" />
    </render_settings>
    
  </RD>
  <ImageData WholeExtent="0 127 0 127 0 0"></ImageData>
</VTKFile>
